title: Figure 23. Delta-GEM Breakup Percentages (line graph)
description: Line graph plotting Breakup Percent (%) against Failure Time (sec), 0–280 s, for the Delta-GEM launch vehicle during simulated random-attitude turns. Three curves show breakup q-alpha values of 5,000, 10,000 and 20,000 deg-lb/ft². Accompanying text (Section 6.3.1, Optimum Mode-5 Shaping Constants) notes that over 50% of vehicles break up if a turn begins between about 10 and 115 seconds. Captioned "Figure 23. Delta-GEM Breakup Percentages"; RTI report dated 9/10/96.
